projects.title: Infinity Library DBMS
projects.description: A premium cyberpunk-themed Library Management DBMS with in-browser SQLite, live data visualization, SQL query explainer, and glassmorphism UI.
projects.modalContent: Engineered a fully self-contained Database Management System using in-browser SQLite via WebAssembly — no XAMPP or external DB servers needed. Features include an interactive SQL code editor with syntax highlighting, live data visualization with Chart.js, a step-by-step SQL execution explainer, query history with local storage persistence, multiple cyberpunk themes, and one-click CSV export. Built entirely with vanilla JavaScript — no frameworks.

projects.title: Quick Serve
projects.description: Instant service booking platform developed during a 24-hour Web-A-Thon utilizing geo-proximity routing.
projects.modalContent: Built during an intense 24-hour hackathon. Engineered a geo-proximity routing algorithm to connect nearby service providers with customers in real-time. Gained hands-on experience in rapid prototyping, full-stack integration, and optimizing database queries for location-based searches.

projects.title: AWS Master Learning Platform

Learned how to communicate complex technical concepts through visual storytelling and interactive UI components.

projects.title: Quick-Suggest
projects.description: A lightning-fast search engine built with a custom C++ HTTP server and Trie data structure for O(L) autocomplete.
projects.modalContent: Developed a custom HTTP server from scratch using WinSock2. Implemented a Prefix Trie data structure to achieve instantaneous search suggestions. Deeply explored socket programming, memory management in C++, and high-performance string processing algorithms.

projects.title: Serverless Turnstile Access System
projects.description: An event-driven serverless access system built utilizing AWS Lambda, API Gateway, and Amazon RDS.
projects.modalContent: Engineered a scalable, event-driven turnstile access system using serverless architecture on AWS. Integrated API Gateway with AWS Lambda functions to handle real-time access requests, backed by a robust Amazon RDS database for data persistence. This project highlights my expertise in cloud computing, serverless deployments, and Python backend development.
